premise: A beautiful courtesan and spy in the imperial capital. She can make almost anyone fall for her, and she uses it to steal secrets for the rebellion.

bible.title: The Gilded Web
bible.era: The Golden Age of the Great Dynasty: horse-drawn carriages, silk gowns, and steel daggers.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: The people of the Empire value filial piety, social hierarchy, and artistic refinement.

travel.description: Messages are carried by swift riders or carrier pigeons. Nobles travel in ornate carriages pulled by horses.

medicine.healing: Traditional herbalism, acupuncture, and cauterization are the limits of medicine.

laws.text: Anyone caught passing imperial state secrets to the rebels or foreign powers shall be executed by a thousand cuts.

norms: Serving the Jade Throne is considered the highest duty, while supporting the rebellion is viewed as absolute chaos.

rules.text: There are no magical spells, monsters, or supernatural powers in the empire; every victory relies on human wit and skill.
The high-class courtesans of the pleasure quarter are esteemed for their arts, but they are legally bound to their houses until bought out.
Treason and espionage against the Jade Throne are investigated by the ruthless Crimson Guard and carry the penalty of execution.

mysteries.question: Who is leaking information about rebel sympathizers to the Crimson Guard?
mysteries.answer: Madam Lin is secretly trading minor details about rebel contacts to buy safety for her own house.
clues: A piece of embroidered silk from the House of Whispers was found inside a Crimson Guard guardhouse.
Madam Lin received a sudden, unexplained tax exemption from the Chancellor's office.
A handwritten ledger showing dates of rebel meetings cross-referenced with Madam Lin's personal diary.

backstory.text: Orphaned at a young age, Mei-Ling was taken in by the House of Whispers and trained in the delicate arts of performance, conversation, and refinement.
As she grew, she witnessed the cruelty and corruption of the imperial court firsthand, leading her to secretly join the Lotus Rebellion as a high-placed informant.

madam-lin.name: Madam Lin
madam-lin.description: A sharp-eyed woman of impeccable posture, carrying a jade smoking pipe.
madam-lin.appearance: An older woman dressed in dark purple silks, her grey hair styled in a tight, elegant bun.

traits.name: Informer
traits.description: She secretly sells minor rebellion secrets to buy safety for her courtesans.

wants: to protect her establishment from imperial raids at any cost
temperament.voice: Polite, smooth, and laced with quiet steel.

secrets: She knows Mei-Ling is a rebel spy but keeps it quiet to use as leverage if the Guard ever arrests her.

general-fong.name: General Fong
general-fong.description: The terrifying commander of the Crimson Guard, famous for his ruthless efficiency.
general-fong.appearance: A tall man with cold, deep-set eyes, wearing a dark red imperial guard tunic and a long steel sword.

wants: to catch the rebel spy operating in the capital

secrets: He has secretly fallen in love with Mei-Ling, which clouds his investigative judgment regarding her.

li-wei.name: Li Wei
li-wei.description: Your main contact in the rebellion, disguised as a silk merchant.
li-wei.appearance: A handsome young man with a warm smile, wearing simple linen robes and carrying a leather satchel.

wants: to overthrow the Emperor and build a free society

secrets: He is prepared to sacrifice his own life to protect Mei-Ling from the Crimson Guard.

chancellor-zhao.name: Chancellor Zhao
chancellor-zhao.description: The corrupt, aging advisor to the Emperor, obsessed with maintaining his power.
chancellor-zhao.appearance: A thin, elderly man wearing lavish, heavy golden silk court robes and expensive jade rings.

wants: to eliminate any potential rivals in the imperial court

secrets: He is embezzling imperial tax funds meant for border defenses and hiding the ledgers in his palace study.

imperial-court.name: The Jade Throne
imperial-court.description: The ruling imperial dynasty, ancient and rigid, demanding absolute loyalty from all subjects.
imperial-court.goal: Exterminate the Lotus Rebellion and maintain absolute control.
imperial-court.methods: Mass arrests, heavy taxes, and public executions to crush dissent.
imperial-court.strength: Tens of thousands of imperial soldiers and a network of elite executioners.

crimson-guard.name: The Crimson Guard
crimson-guard.description: The dreaded secret police of the Emperor, wearing blood-red armor and trained in interrogation and assassination.
crimson-guard.goal: Uncover and destroy the rebel networks in the capital.
crimson-guard.methods: Torture, surveillance, and sudden night raids on suspected rebel safehouses.
crimson-guard.strength: A highly trained, well-armed force of five hundred inquisitors.

lotus-rebellion.name: The Lotus Rebellion
lotus-rebellion.description: A clandestine organization of freedom fighters, corrupt officials, and oppressed peasants aiming to overthrow the dynasty.
lotus-rebellion.goal: Infiltrate the Jade Palace and secure defense blueprints for an upcoming assault.
lotus-rebellion.methods: Subversion, guerrilla warfare, and espionage using double agents.
lotus-rebellion.strength: A scattered network of cells with limited arms but extensive civilian support.

whispering-guild.name: The Whispering Guild
whispering-guild.description: The high-end courtesans, musicians, and servants of the House of Whispers.
whispering-guild.goal: Amass wealth and political leverage by offering luxurious distractions to high-ranking nobles.
whispering-guild.methods: Providing impeccable entertainment while gathering blackmail material on clients.
whispering-guild.strength: High-level connections across the entire imperial bureaucracy.

capital.name: The Imperial Capital
capital.description: The jewel of the dynasty, a walled metropolis of silk-draped plazas, teeming pleasure districts, and imposing fortress walls.

house-of-whispers.name: House of Whispers
house-of-whispers.description: An opulent, three-story establishment in the pleasure quarter, filled with paper lanterns, sweet incense, and private parlor rooms.

imperial-palace.name: The Jade Palace
imperial-palace.description: The massive seat of the Emperor, guarded by towering stone walls and heavily armed Crimson Guard patrols.

rebel-cellar.name: The Hidden Cellar
rebel-cellar.description: A damp, secret basement beneath a tea warehouse in the city slums, used as a meeting point for the rebellion.

fact-1.text: The Jade Throne executes anyone connected to the Lotus Rebellion.

fact-2.text: Madam Lin expects her courtesans to focus entirely on entertaining high-paying noble clients.

fact-3.text: General Fong is deeply suspicious of the House of Whispers, believing it to be a hotbed of espionage.

the-purge.name: The Crimson Guard's Raid
steps: The Crimson Guard arrests low-level rebel sympathizers in the pleasure quarter.
General Fong tortures prisoners to locate the rebellion's main safehouse.
The Guard surrounds the slums, locking down all exits from the capital.
General Fong leads a full assault on the Hidden Cellar.

scene.ended_on: General Fong leans forward over the jade chess set, his eyes locked on yours as he waits for your response.

state.summary: Mei-Ling, a beautiful courtesan and rebel spy, must use her unparalleled charm to extract imperial secrets within the dangerous capital. Under the watchful, suspicious eye of General Fong, she must work quickly to secure defense blueprints before her rebel allies are wiped out.

scenes.narration:
The air in the private salon is thick with the sweet, heavy scent of burning jasmine and the unspoken threat of the Jade Throne. Across the low lacquer table, General Fong slowly swirls his cup of spiced plum wine. The dark red of his Crimson Guard tunic stands out sharply against your delicate silk-cushioned divans, a reminder of the executioner's blade that awaits any soul foolish enough to defy the emperor.

Between you lies an unfinished game of weiqi, the jade stones gleaming under the warm glow of paper lanterns. Fong's cold, analytical eyes never leave your face. He is a man who hunts rebels for sport, yet tonight, he lingers in your quarters, his posture poised between professional suspicion and the quiet pull of your presence.

"They say the Lotus Flower can bloom even in the coldest winter, Mei-Ling," he says, his gravelly voice dropping to a low, deliberate purr. He sets his cup down with a soft click, his hand resting near the hilt of his steel sword. "But I wonder... does it draw its strength from the capital's soil, or from the dark waters of rebellion?"

He leans forward, waiting for your reply. Every breath in the silent room is a gamble.

choices: Smile disarmingly and pour him more wine to deflect his suspicion.
Play a white jade stone and answer him with a poetic riddle.
Gently touch his hand, using your allure to ease his guard.
